# sylve_jail_snapshot (Resource)

A point-in-time ZFS snapshot of a sylve_jail's root dataset. Structurally parallel to sylve_vm_snapshot -- see that resource's own description for the shared reasoning (crash-consistent regardless of running state, immutable name/description, no rename endpoint). See sylve_jail_snapshot_rollback to actually restore one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Structurally identical to sylve_vm_snapshot -- see that resource's
# example for the shared reasoning (crash-consistent, immutable
# name/description).
resource "sylve_jail_snapshot" "before_upgrade" {
  ctid        = sylve_jail.example.ctid
  name        = "before-upgrade"
  description = "before applying package upgrades"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ctid` (Number) CTID of the sylve_jail to snapshot. Immutable.
- `name` (String) Snapshot name. Immutable (no rename endpoint).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description. Immutable, same reason as name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identity -- the snapshot's own numeric ID.
- `root_dataset` (String) ZFS dataset this snapshot covers.
- `snapshot_name` (String) Sylve's own internal ZFS snapshot name (distinct from the display name above).
